about.title: Our Story,
about.subtitle: Baked Fresh
about.description: From a tiny home kitchen in 2019 to the city's favorite artisan bakery, our mission has always remained the same: spreading joy through authentic, handcrafted bakes.
about.p1: We believe that baking is an honest profession. It requires patience, precision, and an unwavering commitment to quality. That's why we don't take shortcuts.
about.p2: Every morning, our master bakers arrive at 4 AM to start the ovens. Our sourdough starters are fed with care, our butter is folded meticulously for those perfect flaky layers, and our cakes are frosted just hours before they reach your celebrations.
about.p3: We source local, organic flour wherever possible and insist on using real Belgian couverture chocolate instead of synthetic compounds.
about.v1Desc: No artificial flavors. We use Madagascar vanilla, authentic butter, and farm-fresh seasonal produce.
about.v2Desc: Good bread takes time. Our authentic sourdough undergoes a 48-hour cold fermentation for complex flavor.
about.v3Desc: We believe a bakery is the heart of a neighborhood. We donate our unsold evening bread to local shelters.
